chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Isma'il ibn 'Abbad, from Khirash, from some of our companions.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ: A narrator in the sanad of this report
key_terms.بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا: An unnamed group from among the companions of the transmitters
key_terms.خِرَاشٍ: A narrator transmitting in this chain
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Meaning: the same as the previous report in wording or ruling

ai.seo_question: How does al-Istibsar transmit a supporting hadith about uncertainty regarding the qiblah on a cloudy day?
ai.summary: This report consists only of a narrator chain followed by an indication that its wording or ruling is the same as a previous hadith. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussion of one who is uncertain about the qiblah on a cloudy day, and serves as corroboration for the preceding narration.
